page: Google Cloud Platform n4a-standard-16 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the n4a server family. It is configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs based on the arm64 CPU architecture. The instance features 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This hardware profile does not include local NVMe storage or bundled GPUs, and it does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that the 16 arm64 vCPUs receive consistent compute resources without resource sharing or burstable degradation. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a balanced resource option for workloads requiring a steady distribution of compute and memory. Because there is no local storage bundled, storage requirements must be met using external network-attached block storage.

This instance is designed for general-purpose workloads, including web serving, application servers, containerized microservices, and distributed development environments. The arm64 architecture offers a power-efficient hardware profile, which translates to qualitative cost efficiency for multi-threaded applications that are compiled and optimized for ARM instruction sets.
